founders.question: Who founded On-Line Systems with Roberta Williams?
founders.fact: Ken and Roberta Williams founded On-Line Systems, later Sierra On-Line, in 1979.

founders.question: In which California city did On-Line Systems start?
founders.fact: The Williamses founded On-Line Systems in Simi Valley, California.

founders.question: Which 1980 game is credited as the first graphic adventure?
founders.fact: Mystery House, released in May 1980, is credited as the first graphic adventure.

founders.question: Who designed Mystery House and drew its pictures?
founders.fact: Roberta Williams designed and illustrated Mystery House. Ken programmed it.

founders.question: Who programmed Mystery House for the Apple II?
founders.fact: Ken Williams programmed Mystery House for the Apple II, turning Roberta's drawings into line-drawing instructions.

founders.question: Which text game hooked Roberta Williams on adventures?
founders.fact: Ken bought Colossal Cave Adventure and the couple played it together; finding few similar games, Roberta decided to write her own.

founders.question: Mystery House borrows from Clue and which novel?
founders.fact: Roberta based the mansion mystery on Agatha Christie's And Then There Were None and on Clue.

founders.question: What was the company called before it became Sierra On-Line?
founders.fact: Ken and Roberta Williams founded the company as On-Line Systems and later renamed it Sierra On-Line.

founders.question: Which Sierra Nevada foothills town was Sierra On-Line's long-time home?
founders.fact: Sierra On-Line was long based in Oakhurst, California, in the Sierra Nevada foothills near Yosemite; moves there from Simi Valley via Coarsegold are dated differently by different sources.

founders.question: Sierra On-Line took its name from the Sierra Nevada.
founders.fact: The company name honors the Sierra Nevada mountains beside its Oakhurst home.

founders.question: Which 1984 Roberta Williams game was built for the IBM PCjr?
founders.fact: IBM commissioned King's Quest for the PCjr. Sierra released it in 1984.

founders.question: What had Ken planned for On-Line Systems to sell at first?
founders.fact: Ken registered On-Line Systems to sell business software before Mystery House took over.

founders.question: Which 1980 Roberta Williams game brought color pictures?
founders.fact: The Wizard and the Princess, Roberta's color follow-up to Mystery House, came out in 1980.

founders.question: Which 1981 text game was later remade as Leisure Suit Larry?
founders.fact: Chuck Benton's Softporn Adventure, published by On-Line Systems, was the basis for Larry.

founders.question: Who designed the Leisure Suit Larry series?
founders.fact: Al Lowe designed Sierra's Leisure Suit Larry games, beginning with the 1987 graphic remake.

founders.question: What did Al Lowe do for a living before designing games?
founders.fact: Al Lowe taught public school music for 15 years and worked as a band director before Sierra.

founders.question: What nickname did Space Quest's creators go by?
founders.fact: Scott Murphy and Mark Crowe, creators of Space Quest, called themselves the Two Guys from Andromeda.

founders.question: Jim Walls designed Police Quest after serving in which force?
founders.fact: Jim Walls, a former California Highway Patrol officer, designed the early Police Quest games.

founders.question: Who designed the Quest for Glory series?
founders.fact: Lori Ann Cole and Corey Cole designed Quest for Glory, first released as Hero's Quest.

founders.question: Who created the Gabriel Knight mysteries?
founders.fact: Jane Jensen designed and wrote Sierra's Gabriel Knight series.

founders.question: Hero's Quest was renamed after a clash with which product?
founders.fact: Milton Bradley's HeroQuest trademark pushed Sierra to rename the series Quest for Glory.

founders.question: In what year did George Lucas start Lucasfilm Games?
founders.fact: Lucasfilm Games was established in May 1982 as Lucasfilm's video game division.

founders.question: Lucasfilm Games became LucasArts in which year?
founders.fact: A 1990 reorganization folded Lucasfilm Games into the LucasArts name.

founders.question: Who created the SCUMM engine to build Maniac Mansion?
founders.fact: Ron Gilbert created SCUMM, the Script Creation Utility for Maniac Mansion.

founders.question: Where did the early Lucasfilm Games group work?
founders.fact: The games group first worked at Lucas's Skywalker Ranch near Nicasio, California.

founders.question: Infocom's founders came out of which school?
founders.fact: Infocom was founded on June 22, 1979 by staff and students tied to MIT.

founders.question: Who served as Infocom's president in its early years?
founders.fact: Joel Berez was Infocom's president. Al Vezza chaired the board.

founders.question: Which company bought Infocom in 1986?
founders.fact: Activision acquired Infocom in June 1986.

founders.question: Which brothers founded Cyan, the studio behind Myst?
founders.fact: Brothers Rand and Robyn Miller founded Cyan and later created Myst.

founders.question: In which Washington city did Cyan begin?
founders.fact: Cyan began in the Millers' family home in Spokane, Washington, and is now based in Mead.

founders.question: Who co-founded Westwood in Las Vegas in 1985?
founders.fact: Brett Sperry and Louis Castle founded Westwood Associates in Las Vegas in 1985.

founders.question: Which set of people founded Revolution Software?
founders.fact: Charles Cecil, Tony Warriner, David Sykes, and Noirin Carmody founded Revolution Software.

founders.question: In which English city is Revolution Software based?
founders.fact: Revolution Software is based in York, England.

founders.question: Who founded the Paris studio Coktel Vision?
founders.fact: Engineer Roland Oskian founded Coktel Vision in Paris in 1984.

founders.question: Sierra's purchase of Coktel Vision was finalized in which year?
founders.fact: Sierra agreed to buy Coktel in 1992. The deal was finalized on October 29, 1993.

founders.question: Who founded Dynamix with Damon Slye?
founders.fact: Jeff Tunnell and Damon Slye founded Dynamix in Eugene, Oregon in 1984.

founders.question: In what year did Sierra acquire Dynamix?
founders.fact: Sierra On-Line acquired the Eugene studio Dynamix in 1990.

founders.question: Brian Moriarty joined Lucasfilm from which company?
founders.fact: Brian Moriarty wrote Wishbringer and Trinity at Infocom, then designed Loom at Lucasfilm.

founders.question: Which designer led Monkey Island, with Tim Schafer and Dave Grossman on his team?
founders.fact: Ron Gilbert led the first Monkey Island games, working with Tim Schafer and Dave Grossman.

founders.question: Who founded Humongous Entertainment with Ron Gilbert?
founders.fact: Ron Gilbert and Shelley Day founded Humongous Entertainment in 1992 after Gilbert left LucasArts.

sierra-games.question: Who is the knight who becomes king in King's Quest?
sierra-games.fact: Sir Graham retrieves Daventry's lost treasures and is crowned king.

sierra-games.question: What is the name of Graham's kingdom?
sierra-games.fact: The King's Quest saga is centered on the kingdom of Daventry.

sierra-games.question: King Graham inherits the crown from which dying king?
sierra-games.fact: In King's Quest I, the aging King Edward sends Graham to recover Daventry's three treasures.

sierra-games.question: Graham must bring back a mirror, a shield, and what else?
sierra-games.fact: The three lost treasures of Daventry are a magic mirror, a magic shield, and a chest of gold.

sierra-games.question: In King's Quest II, whom does Graham set out to rescue?
sierra-games.fact: King's Quest II: Romancing the Throne sends Graham to free Valanice, his future queen.

sierra-games.question: Which witch imprisoned Valanice in a crystal tower?
sierra-games.fact: In King's Quest II, the witch Hagatha holds Valanice captive in a crystal tower.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest II takes Graham to which land?
sierra-games.fact: Graham's search for Valanice is set in the land of Kolyma.

sierra-games.question: In King's Quest III, what name does the wizard give the boy?
sierra-games.fact: The kidnapped prince Alexander is raised as Gwydion, servant of the wizard Manannan.

sierra-games.question: Who is the wizard that enslaved Alexander?
sierra-games.fact: King's Quest III is set in Llewdor, where Manannan keeps Alexander as a slave.

sierra-games.question: What does Alexander finally turn Manannan into?
sierra-games.fact: Alexander brews a spell that transforms Manannan into a cat.

sierra-games.question: Whom do you play for the whole of King's Quest IV?
sierra-games.fact: Roberta Williams made Rosella the sole hero of King's Quest IV: The Perils of Rosella.

sierra-games.question: Which good fairy begs Rosella for help in King's Quest IV?
sierra-games.fact: The fairy Genesta asks Rosella to recover a talisman stolen by the evil fairy Lolotte.

sierra-games.question: Rosella's quest in King's Quest IV is mainly to save whom?
sierra-games.fact: Graham has had a heart attack. Rosella seeks a magic fruit that can restore him.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest IV was sold in both AGI and SCI versions.
sierra-games.fact: Sierra shipped King's Quest IV on the new SCI engine and, as a fallback, on AGI.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest IV was among the first PC games with sound-card music.
sierra-games.fact: The SCI version of King's Quest IV supported add-on sound cards such as the Roland MT-32.

sierra-games.question: Which cranky owl accompanies Graham in King's Quest V?
sierra-games.fact: The wizard Crispin lends Graham his owl Cedric, who comments on the quest.

sierra-games.question: Who steals Graham's castle and family in King's Quest V?
sierra-games.fact: The wizard Mordack, Manannan's brother, teleports Castle Daventry away.

sierra-games.question: Mordack wants revenge because Alexander did what?
sierra-games.fact: Mordack is Manannan's brother and strikes back after Alexander turns Manannan into a cat.

sierra-games.question: Which prince is the hero of King's Quest VI?
sierra-games.fact: King's Quest VI: Heir Today, Gone Tomorrow stars Prince Alexander.

sierra-games.question: Whom does Alexander hope to marry in King's Quest VI?
sierra-games.fact: Alexander is shipwrecked in the Land of the Green Isles and seeks Princess Cassima.

sierra-games.question: What is the vizier's name in King's Quest VI?
sierra-games.fact: The vizier Abdul Alhazred, named for Lovecraft's mad poet, plots against Cassima.

sierra-games.question: Who co-designed King's Quest VI with Roberta Williams?
sierra-games.fact: Jane Jensen co-designed King's Quest VI with Roberta Williams.

sierra-games.question: Which two royals do you play in King's Quest VII?
sierra-games.fact: King's Quest VII: The Princeless Bride alternates between Rosella and her mother Valanice.

sierra-games.question: Who co-designed King's Quest VII with Roberta Williams?
sierra-games.fact: Lorelei Shannon co-wrote and co-designed King's Quest VII with Roberta Williams.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest VIII swaps the royal family for which hero?
sierra-games.fact: Mask of Eternity stars Connor, a new hero, and plays as an action-adventure.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest VIII moved the series toward which style?
sierra-games.fact: Mask of Eternity (1998) added jumping, combat, and a new hero, Connor.

sierra-games.question: What is the name of Space Quest's janitor hero?
sierra-games.fact: Roger Wilco, a sanitation worker, is the unlikely hero of Space Quest.

sierra-games.question: Aboard which ship does Space Quest I begin?
sierra-games.fact: Space Quest I opens on the research ship Arcada, whose Star Generator is stolen.

sierra-games.question: What do the Sariens steal in Space Quest I?
sierra-games.fact: The Sariens raid the Arcada to take the Star Generator.

sierra-games.question: Who is Roger Wilco's recurring nemesis?
sierra-games.fact: Sludge Vohaul schemes against Roger across several Space Quest games.

sierra-games.question: What is Roger Wilco's home planet?
sierra-games.fact: Roger Wilco hails from the planet Xenon, whose people thank him at the end of Space Quest I.

sierra-games.question: Space Quest III mocks a software house called what?
sierra-games.fact: In The Pirates of Pestulon, Roger infiltrates ScumSoft, a parody publisher.

sierra-games.question: Which silly arcade game is hidden in Space Quest III?
sierra-games.fact: Space Quest III includes Astro Chicken, a comic arcade game inside the adventure.

sierra-games.question: Who narrates the CD-ROM version of Space Quest IV?
sierra-games.fact: Laugh-In announcer Gary Owens narrates the talkie edition of Space Quest IV.

sierra-games.question: The Two Guys happily chose point-and-click for Space Quest IV.
sierra-games.fact: Murphy and Crowe preferred the parser. Sierra management overruled them for Space Quest IV.

sierra-games.question: Space Quest IV sends Roger traveling through what?
sierra-games.fact: Roger Wilco and the Time Rippers hops Roger across past and future Space Quest eras.

sierra-games.question: Who is credited as the designer of Space Quest V?
sierra-games.fact: Space Quest V: The Next Mutation credits Mark Crowe as its designer.

sierra-games.question: Space Quest 6 shrinks Roger for a spoof of which 1987 film?
sierra-games.fact: In The Spinal Frontier, Roger is miniaturized and enters a body, a spoof of the 1987 film Innerspace.

sierra-games.question: Who is credited as a designer of Space Quest 6 alongside Scott Murphy?
sierra-games.fact: Josh Mandel designed most of Space Quest 6. Scott Murphy finished the project.

sierra-games.question: Who is the officer you play in the first three Police Quest games?
sierra-games.fact: Jim Walls's Police Quest games star Sonny Bonds of the Lytton police.

sierra-games.question: In which fictional city does Sonny Bonds work?
sierra-games.fact: The first three Police Quest games are set in the fictional California city of Lytton.

sierra-games.question: What is drug lord Jessie Bains called in Police Quest?
sierra-games.fact: Police Quest: In Pursuit of the Death Angel pits Sonny Bonds against Jessie Bains.

sierra-games.question: Who is the playable detective in Police Quest: Open Season?
sierra-games.fact: Open Season drops Sonny Bonds for Los Angeles homicide detective John Carey.

sierra-games.question: Open Season moves the series from Lytton to which real city?
sierra-games.fact: Police Quest: Open Season is set in Los Angeles, not fictional Lytton.

sierra-games.question: Who designed and wrote Police Quest: Open Season?
sierra-games.fact: Sierra employee Tammy Dargan wrote and designed most of Open Season; Daryl F. Gates, former LAPD chief, is billed as its author.

sierra-games.question: What is Leisure Suit Larry's last name?
sierra-games.fact: Al Lowe's hero is Larry Laffer, a hopeful lounge lizard in a white leisure suit.

sierra-games.question: Larry looks for love in a city named what, winking at Las Vegas?
sierra-games.fact: Larry 1 is set in Lost Wages, a fictional city in the Las Vegas Valley.

sierra-games.question: What blocks kids at the start of Leisure Suit Larry 1?
sierra-games.fact: Because Larry 1 is for adults, it opens with trivia questions meant as an age check.

sierra-games.question: Which number did the Larry series famously skip?
sierra-games.fact: There is no Leisure Suit Larry 4. Larry 5 follows Larry 3 on purpose.

sierra-games.question: What is the joke subtitle hung on the never-made Larry 4?
sierra-games.fact: Fans and Sierra jokingly call the absent game Leisure Suit Larry 4: The Missing Floppies.

sierra-games.question: Which jazz pianist shares the lead role in Leisure Suit Larry 3?
sierra-games.fact: Leisure Suit Larry 3 (1989) is titled for Passionate Patti, a jazz pianist who becomes a playable lead alongside Larry.

sierra-games.question: Leisure Suit Larry 6 is set in what kind of place?
sierra-games.fact: Larry 6: Shape Up or Slip Out sends Larry to a luxury health spa.

sierra-games.question: Leisure Suit Larry 7: Love for Sail is set where?
sierra-games.fact: Larry 7 takes Larry and Patti aboard a cruise ship.

sierra-games.question: Larry 3 ends at Sierra's headquarters in which California town?
sierra-games.fact: Larry 3 ends with Larry and Patti at Sierra's Coarsegold, California headquarters, where Larry goes on to code games.

sierra-games.question: Quest for Glory first shipped under what title?
sierra-games.fact: The first game was Hero's Quest: So You Want to Be a Hero, then renamed Quest for Glory.

sierra-games.question: What valley do you save in the first Quest for Glory?
sierra-games.fact: Quest for Glory I is set in the valley of Spielburg.

sierra-games.question: Who cursed the valley of Spielburg in Quest for Glory I?
sierra-games.fact: In Quest for Glory I, the ogress Baba Yaga has cursed Spielburg and its baron.

sierra-games.question: Which trio are the starting jobs in Quest for Glory?
sierra-games.fact: You begin as a fighter, a magic user, or a thief. Paladin can come later through honorable play.

sierra-games.question: Behaving honorably in Quest for Glory can make you a what?
sierra-games.fact: A hero who plays honorably can become a paladin, beyond the three starting classes.

sierra-games.question: Quest for Glory II is set in and around which city?
sierra-games.fact: Trial by Fire moves the hero to the desert city of Shapeir and the cursed city of Raseir.

sierra-games.question: Shapeir's wizards study at the Wizards' Institute of what?
sierra-games.fact: In Quest for Glory II, a magic user can graduate from the Wizards' Institute of Technocery.

sierra-games.question: Who is the villainous wizard of Quest for Glory II?
sierra-games.fact: Ad Avis is the dark wizard behind the troubles of Shapeir and Raseir.

sierra-games.question: Who brings the hero to the Liontaur city of Tarna?
sierra-games.fact: In Quest for Glory III, Rakeesh the Paladin brings the hero to Tarna, the Liontaur city.

sierra-games.question: Quest for Glory III takes place in which land?
sierra-games.fact: Wages of War is set in Fricana, a jungle and savannah country that includes the Liontaur city of Tarna.

sierra-games.question: Quest for Glory IV is set in which gloomy land?
sierra-games.fact: Shadows of Darkness brings the hero to Mordavia, a land of Eastern European folklore.

sierra-games.question: Quest for Glory IV was notorious at launch for what?
sierra-games.fact: Shadows of Darkness shipped with severe bugs and needed patches.

sierra-games.question: The last Quest for Glory is set in which Mediterranean land?
sierra-games.fact: Quest for Glory V: Dragon Fire is set in the Greek-inspired land of Silmaria.

sierra-games.question: You can import your Quest for Glory hero into the next game.
sierra-games.fact: The series lets you carry the same hero, stats, and job forward from game to game.

sierra-games.question: Which wizard, with his familiar Fenrus, lives near Spielburg?
sierra-games.fact: Erasmus the wizard and his rat familiar Fenrus are recurring Quest for Glory characters, found near Spielburg in the first game.

sierra-games.question: Gabriel Knight's first mystery is set in which city?
sierra-games.fact: Sins of the Fathers (1993) is a voodoo mystery set in New Orleans.

sierra-games.question: What is the German title of Gabriel's monster-hunting family?
sierra-games.fact: Gabriel inherits the family role of Schattenjager, a shadow hunter.

sierra-games.question: Who is Gabriel Knight's researcher and assistant?
sierra-games.fact: Grace Nakimura helps run St. George's Books and does Gabriel's research.

sierra-games.question: Who voices Gabriel in the talkie version of Sins of the Fathers?
sierra-games.fact: Tim Curry voices Gabriel Knight in the 1993 game.

sierra-games.question: The Beast Within is about which kind of monster?
sierra-games.fact: Gabriel Knight 2: The Beast Within is a werewolf mystery set in Bavaria.

sierra-games.question: Gabriel Knight 2 is set in and around which city?
sierra-games.fact: The Beast Within takes Gabriel and Grace to Munich and the Bavarian countryside.

sierra-games.question: Who plays Gabriel on screen in the live-action Beast Within?
sierra-games.fact: Dean Erickson plays Gabriel in the full-motion-video game The Beast Within.

sierra-games.question: Gabriel Knight 1 is performed mostly as live-action video.
sierra-games.fact: Sins of the Fathers is a voiced animated adventure. The Beast Within is the live-action one.

sierra-games.question: Who composed the Gabriel Knight scores and later married Jane Jensen?
sierra-games.fact: Composer Robert Holmes scored the Gabriel Knight games and married designer Jane Jensen.

sierra-games.question: Gabriel Knight 3 is set near which French village?
sierra-games.fact: Blood of the Sacred, Blood of the Damned is set around Rennes-le-Chateau in southern France.

sierra-games.question: What is the name of Sierra's 1920s sleuth?
sierra-games.fact: Laura Bow investigates in The Colonel's Bequest and The Dagger of Amon Ra.

sierra-games.question: The Colonel's Bequest is set in which decade?
sierra-games.fact: The Colonel's Bequest (1989) is a mansion murder mystery set in the 1920s.

sierra-games.question: Who created the Laura Bow Mysteries series?
sierra-games.fact: Roberta Williams created the Laura Bow series; The Colonel's Bequest (1989) was its first game, with Jacqueline Austin as credited designer.

sierra-games.question: The Dagger of Amon Ra moves Laura Bow to which city?
sierra-games.fact: In The Dagger of Amon Ra, Laura investigates murders at a New York museum.

sierra-games.question: Who designed The Dagger of Amon Ra?
sierra-games.fact: Bruce Balfour designed the second Laura Bow mystery, The Dagger of Amon Ra (1992).

sierra-games.question: Who designed the horror game Phantasmagoria?
sierra-games.fact: Roberta Williams designed Phantasmagoria, Sierra's 1995 live-action horror adventure.

sierra-games.question: What is the heroine's name in Phantasmagoria?
sierra-games.fact: Writer Adrienne Delaney moves into a cursed mansion with her husband Don.

sierra-games.question: Phantasmagoria originally shipped on how many CD-ROMs?
sierra-games.fact: The 1995 retail release of Phantasmagoria filled seven CD-ROMs, one chapter each.

sierra-games.question: Who plays Adrienne in Phantasmagoria?
sierra-games.fact: Victoria Morsell plays Adrienne Delaney in the filmed scenes.

sierra-games.question: What stage name does the evil magician use in Phantasmagoria?
sierra-games.fact: The mansion's magician, Zoltan Carnovasch, performed as Carno.

sierra-games.question: Roberta Williams designed Phantasmagoria: A Puzzle of Flesh.
sierra-games.fact: Lorelei Shannon designed the 1996 sequel. Roberta designed the first Phantasmagoria.

sierra-games.question: Who designed Conquests of Camelot and Conquests of the Longbow?
sierra-games.fact: Writer Christy Marx designed both Conquests adventures for Sierra.

sierra-games.question: Whom do you play in Conquests of Camelot?
sierra-games.fact: Conquests of Camelot puts you in King Arthur's place on a quest for the Grail.

sierra-games.question: Whom do you play in Conquests of the Longbow?
sierra-games.fact: Conquests of the Longbow (1991) is Christy Marx's Robin Hood adventure.

sierra-games.question: What is the boy's name in EcoQuest?
sierra-games.fact: EcoQuest: The Search for Cetus stars a boy named Adam and a dolphin friend.

sierra-games.question: What is the dolphin's name in EcoQuest?
sierra-games.fact: Adam's companion in EcoQuest is Delphineus the dolphin.

sierra-games.question: Who co-designed EcoQuest with Gano Haine?
sierra-games.fact: Jane Jensen and Gano Haine designed EcoQuest early in Jensen's time at Sierra.

sierra-games.question: Freddy Pharkas works on the frontier as a what?
sierra-games.fact: Al Lowe and Josh Mandel's comedy stars frontier pharmacist Freddy Pharkas.

sierra-games.question: Freddy Pharkas is set in a town named for Sierra's real home area. Which?
sierra-games.fact: The western town of Coarsegold winks at the California town beside Sierra.

sierra-games.question: What is Pepper's dog called in Pepper's Adventures in Time?
sierra-games.fact: Pepper and her dog Lockjaw meet Benjamin Franklin in Pepper's Adventures in Time.

sierra-games.question: Pepper's Adventures in Time sends her to meet whom?
sierra-games.fact: The educational adventure Pepper's Adventures in Time visits Benjamin Franklin.

sierra-games.question: Which of these is one of the routes in Gold Rush!?
sierra-games.fact: Gold Rush! lets Jerrod reach the 1849 gold fields via Cape Horn, Panama, or overland.

sierra-games.question: Who designed the thriller Codename: ICEMAN?
sierra-games.fact: Jim Walls designed Codename: ICEMAN, a modern techno-thriller, between Police Quest games.

sierra-games.question: What is the hero's name in Codename: ICEMAN?
sierra-games.fact: Codename: ICEMAN stars secret agent Johnny Westland.

sierra-games.question: In Manhunter, Earth has been conquered by beings called what?
sierra-games.fact: Manhunter: New York and its sequel put you under the eye-like alien Orbs.

sierra-games.question: Which duo's studio Evryware made the Manhunter games for Sierra?
sierra-games.fact: Brothers Barry and Dave Murry of Evryware designed the Manhunter adventures.

sierra-games.question: Which future Leisure Suit Larry creator designed Sierra's Black Cauldron?
sierra-games.fact: Al Lowe designed The Black Cauldron (1986), Sierra's adventure based on the Disney film.

sierra-games.question: Who designed the family adventure Torin's Passage?
sierra-games.fact: Al Lowe designed Torin's Passage (1995), a family fantasy starring Torin and Boogle.

sierra-games.question: What is the name of Torin's small sidekick?
sierra-games.fact: In Torin's Passage, Torin travels with a shape-shifting companion named Boogle.

sierra-games.question: Which Sierra studio made Betrayal at Krondor?
sierra-games.fact: Dynamix developed Betrayal at Krondor (1993), set in Raymond Feist's Midkemia.

sierra-games.question: Betrayal in Antara dropped the license of which author?
sierra-games.fact: Betrayal in Antara (1997) is a Sierra follow-up that could not use Feist's world.

sierra-games.question: Sierra's adventure RAMA is based on a novel by whom?
sierra-games.fact: RAMA (1996), from Sierra's Dynamix, adapts Arthur C. Clarke's Rendezvous with Rama.

sierra-games.question: Sierra published an early adventure of which Jim Henson film?
sierra-games.fact: Sierra released The Dark Crystal adventure in 1983, tied to Jim Henson's film.

sierra-games.question: Which huge 1982 Roberta Williams game hops across all of history?
sierra-games.fact: Time Zone (1982) is Roberta Williams's enormous adventure spanning many eras.

sierra-games.question: What does AGI, Sierra's first adventure engine, stand for?
sierra-games.fact: AGI is the Adventure Game Interpreter used for Sierra adventures from King's Quest through the late 1980s.

sierra-games.question: What does SCI stand for?
sierra-games.fact: SCI is the Sierra Creative Interpreter, introduced in 1988 with King's Quest IV.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest V led Sierra's shift to which interface?
sierra-games.fact: King's Quest V replaced the typed parser with an icon-driven point-and-click interface.

sierra-games.question: Scott Murphy wanted Space Quest deaths to earn the player what?
sierra-games.fact: Scott Murphy liked a fun death, so a Space Quest failure should still earn the player a laugh.

sierra-games.question: Which early Sierra adventure was numbered Hi-Res Adventure #0?
sierra-games.fact: Mission Asteroid was released as Hi-Res Adventure #0, though it was the second release.

sierra-games.question: King's Quest IV's story is played out over about one day.
sierra-games.fact: King's Quest IV spans 24 in-game hours, a day and night that pass much faster than real time.

sierra-online.question: What was Sierra's online service called when it opened in 1991?
sierra-online.fact: Sierra launched The Sierra Network in 1991 as a graphical online game and chat service.

sierra-online.question: What was The Sierra Network renamed under AT&T?
sierra-online.fact: After AT&T invested, The Sierra Network was rechristened The ImagiNation Network.

sierra-online.question: Which Sierra co-founder championed the online network?
sierra-online.fact: Ken Williams conceived The Sierra Network as a social, graphical online world.

sierra-online.question: The Sierra Network was a text-only bulletin board.
sierra-online.fact: TSN used a graphical interface, avatars, and pictured lands, not a text-only BBS.

sierra-online.question: Ken Williams first pictured the service helping his grandmother find what?
sierra-online.fact: Ken Williams said he wanted his grandmother to be able to pick up a card game from home at an affordable cost.

sierra-online.question: What was Ken's early set-top box idea called, before the PC service?
sierra-online.fact: Williams first proposed a cheap TV unit called the Constant Companion, then shifted to PCs.

sierra-online.question: Which Sierra programmer built the multiplayer version of SCI for TSN?
sierra-online.fact: Lead system programmer Jeff Stephenson adapted Sierra's Creative Interpreter for online play.

sierra-online.question: What was TSN's tool for building a face avatar called?
sierra-online.fact: FaceMaker let members assemble a face from parts and use it in games and chat.

sierra-online.question: FaceMaker's mix-and-match faces were inspired by which toy?
sierra-online.fact: The modular FaceMaker avatar was inspired by Mr. Potato Head.

sierra-online.question: Which TSN land was the adults-only Leisure Suit Larry area?
sierra-online.fact: LarryLand was the adult theme area, with casino games and a virtual bar.

sierra-online.question: Which family area offered mini-golf, paintball, and Red Baron?
sierra-online.fact: SierraLand was the all-ages land, with mini-golf, paintball, Red Baron, and Graffiti.

sierra-online.question: Where did members play bridge, chess, checkers, and backgammon?
sierra-online.fact: The Clubhouse held traditional table games such as bridge, chess, checkers, and backgammon.

sierra-online.question: What was TSN's first big dungeon role-playing game?
sierra-online.fact: The Shadow of Yserbius, developed by Joe Ybarra, launched on TSN in 1991.

sierra-online.question: Which 1993 game followed The Shadow of Yserbius?
sierra-online.fact: The Fates of Twinion (1993) was the second of the three Yserbius dungeon games.

sierra-online.question: Which 1995 game completed the Yserbius trilogy?
sierra-online.fact: The Ruins of Cawdor (1995) followed Yserbius and The Fates of Twinion.

sierra-online.question: Who developed The Shadow of Yserbius for Sierra?
sierra-online.fact: Joe Ybarra of Ybarra Productions developed The Shadow of Yserbius.

sierra-online.question: In 1994 AT&T bought the rest of ImagiNation for about how much?
sierra-online.fact: On November 15, 1994, AT&T bought the remaining ImagiNation shares for $40 million.

sierra-online.question: Who bought the ImagiNation Network from AT&T in 1996?
sierra-online.fact: America Online bought the ImagiNation Network from AT&T in 1996.

sierra-online.question: Bill Gates and Microsoft also showed interest in buying TSN.
sierra-online.fact: In a May 1993 letter, Bill Gates expressed disappointment that Sierra had chosen AT&T over Microsoft.

lucasarts.question: SCUMM was built so Lucasfilm could make which game?
lucasarts.fact: Ron Gilbert created SCUMM, the Script Creation Utility for Maniac Mansion.

lucasarts.question: SCUMM stands for Script Creation Utility for Maniac Mansion.
lucasarts.fact: The engine's name is an acronym of Script Creation Utility for Maniac Mansion.

lucasarts.question: In what year did Lucasfilm release Maniac Mansion?
lucasarts.fact: Maniac Mansion, designed by Ron Gilbert and Gary Winnick, came out in 1987.

lucasarts.question: Who co-designed Maniac Mansion with Ron Gilbert?
lucasarts.fact: Artist Gary Winnick co-designed Maniac Mansion with Ron Gilbert.

lucasarts.question: What color is the meteor that crashed near the Edison mansion?
lucasarts.fact: A purple meteor mutates the Edison family in Maniac Mansion.

lucasarts.question: What is the mad scientist in Maniac Mansion called?
lucasarts.fact: Dr. Fred Edison is the mad scientist of Maniac Mansion.

lucasarts.question: What is the name of Dr. Fred's son in Maniac Mansion?
lucasarts.fact: Weird Ed is Dr. Fred and Nurse Edna's son. Dead Cousin Ted is a different Edison.

lucasarts.question: Which playable kid from Maniac Mansion returns in Day of the Tentacle?
lucasarts.fact: Bernard Bernoulli, one of the seven Maniac Mansion kids, stars in Day of the Tentacle.

lucasarts.question: What humble houseplant became a LucasArts running gag?
lucasarts.fact: Chuck the Plant, first seen in Maniac Mansion, cameos through later LucasArts games.

lucasarts.question: Maniac Mansion lets you pick only one kid for the whole game.
lucasarts.fact: You choose a team from seven kids, and different teams open different solutions.

lucasarts.question: What is Zak McKracken's day job?
lucasarts.fact: Zak McKracken writes for a supermarket tabloid before the aliens show up.

lucasarts.question: Who was the lead designer of Zak McKracken?
lucasarts.fact: David Fox led Zak McKracken and the Alien Mindbenders (1988), with help from Ron Gilbert.

lucasarts.question: Lucasfilm's Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade adventure came out in which year?
lucasarts.fact: The graphic adventure of Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade was released in 1989.

lucasarts.question: What score does the Last Crusade adventure keep for clever play?
lucasarts.fact: The game tracks an Indy Quotient, rewarding puzzle solutions and optional discoveries.

lucasarts.question: Who is the hero of Loom?
lucasarts.fact: Loom stars Bobbin Threadbare, youngest member of the Guild of Weavers.

lucasarts.question: Who designed Loom?
lucasarts.fact: Infocom veteran Brian Moriarty designed Loom (1990) at Lucasfilm Games.

lucasarts.question: In Loom, spells are cast as short what?
lucasarts.fact: Bobbin casts spells by playing four-note musical drafts on his distaff.

lucasarts.question: Loom's score draws on which ballet?
lucasarts.fact: Loom's music is adapted from Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake.

lucasarts.question: Bobbin belongs to which guild in Loom?
lucasarts.fact: Bobbin Threadbare is a Weaver. Other guilds, such as shepherds and glassmakers, fill the world.

lucasarts.question: What is the hero's full name in The Secret of Monkey Island?
lucasarts.fact: You play Guybrush Threepwood, a young man who wants to be a pirate.

lucasarts.question: Who is the governor Guybrush falls for?
lucasarts.fact: Elaine Marley is governor of Melee Island and Guybrush's love.

lucasarts.question: What is the name of the ghost pirate in Monkey Island?
lucasarts.fact: The ghost pirate LeChuck is Guybrush's rival across the Monkey Island games.

lucasarts.question: The Secret of Monkey Island opens on which island?
lucasarts.fact: Guybrush begins on Melee Island, then later sails on to Monkey Island.

lucasarts.question: Monkey Island sword fights are won with what?
lucasarts.fact: Swordplay is a puzzle of pirate insults and the right comebacks, not twitch timing.

lucasarts.question: In what year did The Secret of Monkey Island come out?
lucasarts.fact: The Secret of Monkey Island, from Lucasfilm Games, was released in 1990.

lucasarts.question: What is the grog shop on Melee Island called?
lucasarts.fact: Pirates on Melee Island drink at the SCUMM Bar, named for the engine.

lucasarts.question: Who sells Guybrush a ship he will regret?
lucasarts.fact: Stan the salesman sticks Guybrush with a barely floating ship.

lucasarts.question: Which stranded hermit helps Guybrush on Monkey Island?
lucasarts.fact: Herman Toothrot is the castaway living on Monkey Island.

lucasarts.question: Insult sword fighting was inspired by films starring whom?
lucasarts.fact: The designers based the insult duels on swashbuckling films starring Errol Flynn.

lucasarts.question: Monkey Island 2 is subtitled what?
lucasarts.fact: The 1991 sequel is Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge.

lucasarts.question: Which game was the first to use iMUSE?
lucasarts.fact: Michael Land and Peter McConnell's iMUSE debuted in Monkey Island 2 (1991).

lucasarts.question: Who built the iMUSE music system?
lucasarts.fact: Composers Michael Land and Peter McConnell developed iMUSE at LucasArts.

lucasarts.question: What does iMUSE do for a scene?
lucasarts.fact: iMUSE, the Interactive Music Streaming Engine, transitions music as the action changes.

lucasarts.question: Which of these islands is in Monkey Island 2?
lucasarts.fact: Monkey Island 2 visits Scabb Island, Phatt Island, Booty Island, and Dinky Island.

lucasarts.question: Which cartographer helps Guybrush with the Big Whoop map in MI2?
lucasarts.fact: Wally is the nervous cartographer of Monkey Island 2.

lucasarts.question: Who bullies Guybrush on Scabb Island?
lucasarts.fact: The tiny bully Largo LaGrande extorts Guybrush on Scabb Island.

lucasarts.question: In the Monkey Island 2 ending, Big Whoop turns out to be what?
lucasarts.fact: The ending of Monkey Island 2 places Big Whoop in an amusement park.

lucasarts.question: Day of the Tentacle was released in which year?
lucasarts.fact: Day of the Tentacle, a Maniac Mansion sequel, was released in 1993.

lucasarts.question: Who designed Day of the Tentacle?
lucasarts.fact: Tim Schafer and Dave Grossman designed Day of the Tentacle.

lucasarts.question: Name the three playable kids in Day of the Tentacle.
lucasarts.fact: You swap among Bernard, Hoagie, and Laverne, each stuck in a different time.

lucasarts.question: Purple Tentacle becomes a genius after drinking what?
lucasarts.fact: A sip of toxic sludge turns Purple Tentacle into a would-be world conqueror.

lucasarts.question: What entire older game is playable on a computer inside Day of the Tentacle?
lucasarts.fact: A PC in Weird Ed's room contains the whole original Maniac Mansion.

lucasarts.question: Hoagie is sent to which era in Day of the Tentacle?
lucasarts.fact: Hoagie lands in the colonial past, Bernard stays in the present, and Laverne goes to the future.

lucasarts.question: Sam & Max Hit the Road came out in which year?
lucasarts.fact: LucasArts released Sam & Max Hit the Road in 1993.

lucasarts.question: In Sam & Max, what kind of animal is Sam?
lucasarts.fact: Sam is an upright dog in a suit. Max is his small rabbit-like partner.

lucasarts.question: What sort of creature is Max?
lucasarts.fact: Max is Sam's short, furious, rabbit-like partner in the Freelance Police.

lucasarts.question: Who created the Sam & Max comics behind the game?
lucasarts.fact: Steve Purcell's Sam & Max comics were adapted by LucasArts, with Purcell on the team.

lucasarts.question: What do Sam and Max call their two-person agency?
lucasarts.fact: Sam and Max are the Freelance Police.

lucasarts.question: Whose kidnapping starts Sam & Max Hit the Road?
lucasarts.fact: The case opens when Bruno, a bigfoot, disappears from a local attraction.

lucasarts.question: Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis was released in which year?
lucasarts.fact: Fate of Atlantis, an original Indy story, was released in 1992.

lucasarts.question: Who designed Fate of Atlantis?
lucasarts.fact: Hal Barwood and Noah Falstein designed Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis.

lucasarts.question: Fate of Atlantis offers which three ways to play?
lucasarts.fact: You choose a Team path, a Wits path, or a Fists path, each with different puzzles.

lucasarts.question: Who is Indy's partner in Fate of Atlantis?
lucasarts.fact: Psychic Sophia Hapgood joins Indy for the original Atlantis story.

lucasarts.question: Fate of Atlantis is a direct adaptation of an Indy film.
lucasarts.fact: Fate of Atlantis is an original story by Hal Barwood and Noah Falstein, not a movie tie-in.

lucasarts.question: Full Throttle was released in which year?
lucasarts.fact: Tim Schafer's biker adventure Full Throttle was released in 1995.

lucasarts.question: Who leads the Polecats in Full Throttle?
lucasarts.fact: Ben is the leader of the Polecats motorcycle gang.

lucasarts.question: Full Throttle's last motorcycle company is called what?
lucasarts.fact: Malcolm Corley's Corley Motors is the last motorcycle maker in Ben's world.

lucasarts.question: Who is the suit that frames Ben in Full Throttle?
lucasarts.fact: Adrian Ripburger murders Malcolm Corley and pins the crime on Ben.

lucasarts.question: Who designed Full Throttle?
lucasarts.fact: Tim Schafer designed and directed Full Throttle.

lucasarts.question: Which mechanic repairs Ben's bike in Full Throttle?
lucasarts.fact: Maureen, called Mo, is the tough mechanic who helps Ben.

lucasarts.question: Whose story idea launched the long production of The Dig?
lucasarts.fact: Steven Spielberg supplied the original story idea that became The Dig.

lucasarts.question: Who finished The Dig as its designer after earlier leads left?
lucasarts.fact: The Dig passed through several designers, including Brian Moriarty. Sean Clark finished it.

lucasarts.question: What is the astronaut hero of The Dig called?
lucasarts.fact: The Dig stars commander Boston Low, with Maggie Robbins and Ludger Brink.

lucasarts.question: Grim Fandango was released in which year?
lucasarts.fact: LucasArts released Tim Schafer's Grim Fandango in 1998.

lucasarts.question: What is the travel agent's name in Grim Fandango?
lucasarts.fact: You play Manny Calavera, a travel agent in the Land of the Dead.

lucasarts.question: Manny Calavera works for which office?
lucasarts.fact: Manny sells travel packages for the Department of Death.

lucasarts.question: What engine replaced SCUMM for Grim Fandango?
lucasarts.fact: Grim Fandango was the first LucasArts adventure since Labyrinth not to use SCUMM. It runs on GrimE.

lucasarts.question: GrimE scripts are written in which language?
lucasarts.fact: Programmer Bret Mogilefsky built GrimE around the Lua scripting language.

lucasarts.question: Who composed the score of Grim Fandango?
lucasarts.fact: Peter McConnell composed Grim Fandango's mix of jazz, folk, and big-band themes.

lucasarts.question: Whom does Manny chase across the Land of the Dead?
lucasarts.fact: Manny tries to make good to Meche Colomar, a client cheated out of her rightful journey.

lucasarts.question: Who is Manny's huge demon driver and mechanic?
lucasarts.fact: Glottis, a speed-loving demon, drives and repairs Manny's vehicles.

lucasarts.question: Grim Fandango's look mixes film noir with which tradition?
lucasarts.fact: The art combines film noir with Mexican Day of the Dead calavera imagery and Art Deco.

lucasarts.question: The Curse of Monkey Island was released in which year?
lucasarts.fact: The Curse of Monkey Island, the third game, was released in 1997.

lucasarts.question: Who designed The Curse of Monkey Island?
lucasarts.fact: Larry Ahern and Jonathan Ackley designed The Curse of Monkey Island.

lucasarts.question: What is the name of the demonic talking skull in Curse of Monkey Island?
lucasarts.fact: Murray is a wisecracking demonic skull who cannot move on his own.

lucasarts.question: Ron Gilbert designed The Curse of Monkey Island.
lucasarts.fact: Larry Ahern and Jonathan Ackley designed the 1997 game. Gilbert had been gone for years.

lucasarts.question: Before Maniac Mansion, Lucasfilm made an adventure of which film?
lucasarts.fact: Labyrinth (1986), designed with David Fox, was Lucasfilm's adventure of the Jim Henson film.

lucasarts.question: Which early Lucasfilm game strands you on a fractal planet?
lucasarts.fact: Rescue on Fractalus!, one of the first Lucasfilm games, flew rescue runs over a fractal world.

lucasarts.question: Putt-Putt Joins the Parade was built with the SCUMM engine.
lucasarts.fact: Ron Gilbert's Humongous Entertainment reused SCUMM for Putt-Putt, Freddi Fish, and Pajama Sam.

lucasarts.question: Who programmed GrimE and chose Lua for it?
lucasarts.fact: Bret Mogilefsky programmed GrimE and adopted Lua so designers could script the game.

adventure-90s.question: Which studio made Myst?
adventure-90s.fact: Rand and Robyn Miller's Cyan developed Myst, published by Broderbund in 1993.

adventure-90s.question: Myst was published by which company?
adventure-90s.fact: Broderbund published Cyan's Myst in 1993.

adventure-90s.question: In what year was Myst released?
adventure-90s.fact: Myst was first released in 1993, for the Macintosh.

adventure-90s.question: Who writes the linking books that create Myst's ages?
adventure-90s.fact: Atrus writes linking books that open onto the ages. His sons are Sirrus and Achenar.

adventure-90s.question: What are the names of Atrus's two sons in Myst?
adventure-90s.fact: Sirrus and Achenar are trapped in books on Myst Island. Their father is Atrus.

adventure-90s.question: How does Myst show its world?
adventure-90s.fact: Myst is a first-person tour of pre-rendered scenes you click through.

adventure-90s.question: What is the 1997 sequel to Myst called?
adventure-90s.fact: Riven, released in 1997, is the sequel to Myst.

adventure-90s.question: Who is the villain of Riven, and Atrus's father?
adventure-90s.fact: Gehn, Atrus's father, is the self-declared ruler of the world of Riven and its main villain.

adventure-90s.question: Who co-designed Riven with Robyn Miller?
adventure-90s.fact: Richard Vander Wende co-designed Riven with Robyn Miller; Rand Miller produced it.

adventure-90s.question: Which studio made The 7th Guest?
adventure-90s.fact: Graeme Devine and Rob Landeros's Trilobyte developed The 7th Guest.

adventure-90s.question: Who co-founded Trilobyte and created The 7th Guest?
adventure-90s.fact: Graeme Devine and Rob Landeros founded Trilobyte and made The 7th Guest.

adventure-90s.question: What is the toymaker villain of The 7th Guest called?
adventure-90s.fact: Henry Stauf, a toymaker, built the haunted mansion of The 7th Guest.

adventure-90s.question: What is the sequel to The 7th Guest?
adventure-90s.fact: Trilobyte followed The 7th Guest with The 11th Hour in 1995.

adventure-90s.question: Which studio made The Legend of Kyrandia?
adventure-90s.fact: Westwood Studios developed The Legend of Kyrandia, released in 1992.

adventure-90s.question: Who is the hero of the first Legend of Kyrandia?
adventure-90s.fact: Brandon, a young prince, must restore Kyrandia after the jester Malcolm uses the Kyragem to corrupt its magic.

adventure-90s.question: Who is the jester villain of Kyrandia?
adventure-90s.fact: Malcolm the court jester is the villain of the first Kyrandia and the hero of the third.

adventure-90s.question: Whom do you play in Kyrandia: The Hand of Fate?
adventure-90s.fact: Book Two, The Hand of Fate (1993), stars the witch Zanthia.

adventure-90s.question: Kyrandia's third game lets you play as whom?
adventure-90s.fact: Malcolm's Revenge (1994) makes you play Malcolm, the villain of the first game, now out for revenge.

adventure-90s.question: Who is the American tourist hero of Broken Sword?
adventure-90s.fact: Broken Sword stars George Stobbart, a tourist caught in a Paris bombing.

adventure-90s.question: Who is George's French partner in Broken Sword?
adventure-90s.fact: Journalist Nico Collard joins George Stobbart in the Broken Sword games.

adventure-90s.question: Broken Sword opens with an explosion in which city?
adventure-90s.fact: A cafe bombing in Paris pulls George Stobbart into the Templar plot.

adventure-90s.question: Which order's secrets drive the first Broken Sword?
adventure-90s.fact: Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars is a modern Templar conspiracy.

adventure-90s.question: What was the American title of the first Broken Sword?
adventure-90s.fact: In the United States, Broken Sword: The Shadow of the Templars was titled Circle of Blood.

adventure-90s.question: Which animal blocks a famous, fiddly puzzle in Broken Sword?
adventure-90s.fact: The goat puzzle is in Ireland: a goat tied to a rope guards the entrance to the underground dig at a castle in Lochmarne.

adventure-90s.question: Who is the hero of Beneath a Steel Sky?
adventure-90s.fact: Robert Foster, stranded in the Gap as a boy and raised by Aboriginal people, is the hero of Beneath a Steel Sky.

adventure-90s.question: What is the name of Foster's robot friend?
adventure-90s.fact: Joey's circuit board is moved from body to body as Foster crosses Union City.

adventure-90s.question: Which comics artist co-designed Beneath a Steel Sky?
adventure-90s.fact: Watchmen artist Dave Gibbons co-designed Beneath a Steel Sky with Charles Cecil of Revolution Software.

adventure-90s.question: What is Foster's walled city called?
adventure-90s.fact: Union City is a city-state controlled by the all-powerful computer LINC.

adventure-90s.question: Revolution's early adventures used which character engine?
adventure-90s.fact: Lure of the Temptress was the first Virtual Theatre game and Beneath a Steel Sky the second; Broken Sword also used it.

adventure-90s.question: Revolution later released Beneath a Steel Sky as freeware.
adventure-90s.fact: Revolution released Beneath a Steel Sky as freeware in August 2003, and ScummVM later supported it.

adventure-90s.question: Revolution's first game, in 1992, was called what?
adventure-90s.fact: Lure of the Temptress (1992) was Revolution's debut and the first Virtual Theatre game.

adventure-90s.question: Which company made Simon the Sorcerer?
adventure-90s.fact: Adventure Soft developed and published Simon the Sorcerer in 1993.

adventure-90s.question: Who voices Simon on the CD version of Simon the Sorcerer?
adventure-90s.fact: Chris Barrie, known for Red Dwarf, voices Simon in the talkie version.

adventure-90s.question: In the Gobliiins series, the number of i's matches the goblin count.
adventure-90s.fact: In the Gobliiins series, the number of i's in the title indicates how many characters you may control.

adventure-90s.question: Which studio made the Gobliiins games?
adventure-90s.fact: Coktel Vision, a French developer, made Gobliiins (1991); Muriel Tramis and Pierre Gilhodes created the series.

adventure-90s.question: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream was co-designed by whom?
adventure-90s.fact: Harlan Ellison co-designed the 1995 game of his story and voiced the computer AM.

adventure-90s.question: Westwood's Blade Runner casts you as whom?
adventure-90s.fact: Westwood's 1997 Blade Runner stars a new detective, Ray McCoy, not Deckard.

adventure-90s.question: Who voices Rincewind in the Discworld adventure?
adventure-90s.fact: Eric Idle voices Rincewind in the 1995 Discworld point-and-click game.

adventure-90s.question: The Discworld games adapt novels by whom?
adventure-90s.fact: The Discworld adventures are based on Terry Pratchett's comic fantasy novels.

adventure-90s.question: Who designed The Last Express?
adventure-90s.fact: Jordan Mechner, of Karateka and Prince of Persia, directed The Last Express.

adventure-90s.question: The Last Express is set aboard which train?
adventure-90s.fact: The Last Express takes place on the Orient Express in July 1914.

adventure-90s.question: What is the hero's name in The Last Express?
adventure-90s.fact: You play Robert Cath, an American doctor who boards the Orient Express and takes his dead friend's identity.

adventure-90s.question: The Last Express plays out in real time.
adventure-90s.fact: The Last Express runs almost entirely in real time, accelerated by a factor of six.

adventure-90s.question: Whom can you play in the 1992 game Alone in the Dark?
adventure-90s.fact: Alone in the Dark lets you investigate Derceto as Edward Carnby or Emily Hartwood.

adventure-90s.question: Who designed Alone in the Dark?
adventure-90s.fact: Frederic Raynal designed Infogrames' Alone in the Dark (1992).

adventure-90s.question: What is the haunted mansion in Alone in the Dark called?
adventure-90s.fact: Edward Carnby investigates the Louisiana mansion Derceto.

adventure-90s.question: Who plays and co-created the detective Tex Murphy?
adventure-90s.fact: Chris Jones of Access Software plays Tex Murphy and led the adventure series.

adventure-90s.question: Whose artwork is Dark Seed's dark world based on?
adventure-90s.fact: Cyberdreams' Dark Seed (1992) bases its dark world on artwork by H.R. Giger.

adventure-90s.question: What is the clay hero of The Neverhood called?
adventure-90s.fact: Doug TenNapel's The Neverhood (1996) is a clay-animated adventure starring Klaymen.

adventure-90s.question: Who created The Neverhood?
adventure-90s.fact: Doug TenNapel created The Neverhood, released by DreamWorks Interactive in 1996.

adventure-90s.question: Which actor stars as the cartoonist in Toonstruck?
adventure-90s.fact: Christopher Lloyd plays Drew Blanc, a cartoonist pulled into his own cartoon, in Toonstruck.

adventure-90s.question: Who created the game Starship Titanic?
adventure-90s.fact: Douglas Adams's Digital Village released Starship Titanic in 1998.

adventure-90s.question: Who designed the cyberpunk adventure Snatcher?
adventure-90s.fact: Hideo Kojima designed Snatcher. The Sega CD edition brought it to English.

adventure-90s.question: What is the hero's name in Little Big Adventure?
adventure-90s.fact: Adeline's Little Big Adventure (1994) stars Twinsen. In the US it was sold as Relentless: Twinsen's Adventure.

adventure-90s.question: Which company developed the graphical Return to Zork in 1993?
adventure-90s.fact: Activision developed Return to Zork (1993), which was released under the Infocom label as the last Zork-series game.

adventure-90s.question: Return to Zork replaced the old text parser with point-and-click.
adventure-90s.fact: Return to Zork (1993) swapped Infocom's text parser for a point-and-click interface.

adventure-90s.question: Who designed the comedy Eric the Unready?
adventure-90s.fact: Bob Bates designed Eric the Unready (1993) at Legend Entertainment.

adventure-90s.question: Who designed Spellcasting 101 after leaving Infocom?
adventure-90s.fact: Steve Meretzky, formerly of Infocom, designed Spellcasting 101 for Legend Entertainment in 1990.

adventure-90s.question: In Bad Mojo, what creature do you play?
adventure-90s.fact: In Bad Mojo (1996) entomologist Roger Samms is turned into a cockroach and crawls through a rundown bar and its sewers.
